review_scope: Independent raw statistics and source-accounting review, followed by review of final manuscript source and all extracted PDF text. This is not external peer review or independent visual inspection. Final visual QA and clean default-restoration receipts are the paper owner's separate checks.
claims_checked: 87 disjoint replacements in 46 files: 582 original proof lines become 226 including preparation; 46 imports and zero helpers give 310 net code lines. The paper claims local patch savings, not an upstream merge or whole-repository reduction.

All 50 census-generated selected edits exactly match final v4 proposals on path, source line range, original-span hash, and replacement bytes. The other 37 were composed outside the census. AI coding assistance is disclosed.

The historical full census has 8637 files and 27 incomplete outcomes. Final targeted discovery has 885 files, 875 complete, 10 incomplete, and 158 isolated proposals. This is not exhaustive expanded-tactic coverage over Mathlib.

All 40 measured paired passes and one warmup pair cover all 46 files: 3680 measured records and 92 warmup records, with no duplicates, omissions, failures, or dropped records. Seven slower files remain.

Independent stdlib recomputation gives original mean 131.18845477257054 seconds, replacement mean 122.33309307682866 seconds, ratio 1.0723872949912292, and conditional 95% whole-block BCa interval [1.0669415438805043, 1.0814098536161436]. Reported endpoint agreement is within 1.6e-15.

The speed-level-blinded 24-pair pilot, owner decision, independent blinded review, and pre-launch root check bind the predeclared 40-pair/four-pair-block design. Ten blocks, 10000 resamples, seed 20261020, half-weight ties, linear empirical quantiles, and whole-block jackknife agree with the frozen plan.

Existing Mathlib proofs are the baseline. Measurement covers warm affected-file Lean compilation, including actual imports, tactic search, proof construction/checking, serialization and C generation. It excludes native C object compilation and Lake dispatch. The result does not isolate an algorithm or measure a full Mathlib build.

The manuscript retains independent representative blocks as assumptions, records pilot drift and confirmation half-run increases of 4.26%/5.14%, and discloses battery 80% to 41% with final discharging status, failed thermal queries, and uncontrolled background activity. No continuous-power or thermal-stability claim is made.
Completeness belongs to the finite rational real-space abstraction. Bounded quantified, pseudometric, additive-group, and opaque-upper-bound paths do not inherit an unqualified completeness claim.

Six checked Lean snippet markers remain bound to the source check. Four main pages use NeurIPS workshop style; references and appendices bring the total to 17. The manuscript makes no submission, acceptance, or ASD certification claim.

Portable status binds the expanded evidence bundle and transport, including both independent recomputation receipts. Compact evidence is distinguished from local-only deep raw archives. Hash attestations are not represented as fresh portable Lean compilations.
